description: Baseline Power Pages fixture records generated by examples/project/baseline/site.mjs.

notExpressed.reason: PAC CLI supports only the tables Learn lists under Supported tables; adx_columnpermissionprofile and adx_columnpermission are not among them, so a site folder cannot carry column permissions. Baseline Secret Profile (deny pqvd_secret for Baseline Readers) is not generated.
The export does not show how a modern list is flagged (backing column not stated on Learn).

Needs an auto-number definition record that the fixture lacks; Learn lists the columns only (learn-ref-webformstep), so adx_createautonumber stays false (its default, which does not exercise the item).

Learn (Use code components in Power Pages): the code component must first be added to the field on the model-driven (Dataverse) form, then enabled with Control Style = Code Component. The fixture's Dataverse forms bind no code component to a column, and a site folder cannot add one to a Dataverse form.
Needs an on-demand classic workflow on the baseline table; the fixture has none.
Offered only for opportunity, incident, quote and sales order (D365 tables the fixture lacks).
Purchase metadata needs D365 commerce tables (quote, order, invoice) the fixture lacks.
Azure Blob Storage needs a storage account and container configured for the site; the fixture has none (note attachments are used).

The enhanced data model stores no map_latitude/map_longitude in list content (upload sent them; read-only Web API read of the stored content on 2026-10-15 shows neither key; export carries neither). The fixture therefore no longer sends them.

Filter Lookup On Relationship (adx.filterrelationship/adx.filterentity in the designer's JSON) needs a relationship between the related table and contact; pqvd_baselineparent has none, so the dynamic lookup sets it empty as the designer does.
Needs a lookup to adx_website on the listed table; pqvd_baselineitem has none (and no second website exists).

Learn (Enhanced view filter for lists): the filter is configured on the underlying model-driven view definition used by the list (condition elements with uitype="contact"/"account"/"adx_website"). A view is a Dataverse solution component, not a site record, so a site folder cannot carry it; the fixture's views have no uitype condition.

Observed: the PAC export's table permission, web role and site setting records carry no adx_websiteid (baseline export table-permissions/*.yml, webrole.yml, sitesetting.yml); the website is implied by the site folder.

Learn (Table permissions, Custom access type): Custom Access is available only for sites enabled for enhanced authorization. The fixture keeps the website record unchanged (adx_enhancedauthorization 0), and enabling enhanced authorization is site-wide.

True needs a code component configured on the list's view (Learn tutorial: Use a configured code component = Yes after adding it to the views); no baseline view has one. False is the default and the export drops it.
True only when the portal user lookup column is an activity party (Learn basic forms: Is Activity Party); the baseline tables are not activity tables.
Site-wide setting: changing it changes the shared site outside /baseline/ (not safe on the shared fixture site). Is Default makes a template the default choice in the site's editing tools.

True needs the 'Power Pages Web API Columns' system view on the table (Learn Web API overview). A view is a Dataverse solution component a site folder cannot carry, and the fixture's views include none; false is the default and exercises nothing.

Not expressible in the site folder: contact and account membership are data associations (N:N powerpagecomponent_mspp_webrole_contact / powerpagecomponent_mspp_webrole_account in the powerpagecomponent and account references), not site records; personas are assigned by the project data.
Needs an ASP.NET user control (.ascx) deployed with the portal host; a Power Pages site cannot add one.
Learn lists the column only (no behaviour or value format); there is no event handler, postback target or documented JSON to point it at.
State true is not set: it belongs to the site's existing Authenticated Users / Anonymous Users roles, and a second default role is not safe on the shared site (baseline roles set false).
Site-wide setting: changing it changes the shared site outside /baseline/ (not safe on the shared fixture site). Date/time formats and the Bootstrap version change every page.
Site-wide setting: changing it changes the shared site outside /baseline/ (not safe on the shared fixture site).
Site-wide setting: changing it changes the shared site outside /baseline/ (not safe on the shared fixture site). Search, profile and registration settings drive pages outside /baseline/.
Site-wide content snippet read by sign-in, header, search or error pages outside /baseline/; overriding it changes the shared site (not safe).

documentationOnly.reason: Runtime session table written by the server while a user fills a multistep form; nothing to configure.
Statement of how permissions are enforced; no configurable value.
Standard vs enhanced data model storage: a property of the environment, not of a record.

caveats.reason: Learn does not name the filter definition JSON keys. The definition now follows the Portal Management app's filter designer (toFetchJSON in web resource mspp_jsoneditor/mspp.jsoneditor.filter.js, read-only from Dataverse 2026-10-15) and the building-permit/program-registration exports; the earlier adx.* shape without the xmlns.adx root rendered 'Liquid error: Value cannot be null. Parameter name: key' live. Rendering of the corrected definition is not yet observed live.

Baseline Item Edit Associated returned HTTP 500 for the editor persona. The record matches the only real export with this source (building-permit Acknowledgement: 756150003 over bp_defaultApplication_Contact, also a 1:N from contact). The test contact has two items through pqvd_contactid (item1, item8; read-only count 2026-10-15) while Learn describes a single related record; the 500 is attributed to that ambiguity, unverified. Fix is in the fixture data (one item per contact), outside this generator.

Baseline Item Edit Geolocation (Bing map type, no address columns, geolocation lookup validator on pqvd_wide) returned HTTP 500 while the Google/Esri geolocation forms without the validator render. Learn: the validator and the Bing map type require Bing Maps settings (Bingmaps/credentials, 'Required'); the fixture sets an invented key (O9), so the page is observed with a key the service rejects. Not separable without a real key; kept as configured.
Learn does not name the basic form settings JSON keys; actions use the {Actions:[{Type}]} shape Mirage reads, placement and dialog keys are unverified.
Only Source = Table (0) is set; Environment Variable (1) needs an environment variable definition the fixture lacks.

Learn names the timeline settings by display name only; the JSON keys follow the notes settings shape. Shape verified: the export stores adx_type 756150000 and adx_timeline_settings unchanged, and names the record '<form name> ' (empty target), as for notes. Rendering of these keys is not verified.

Exercised through Layout 2 Column Wide Left (Learn: Built-in web templates), extended by name as the site's web template record is named; Layout 1 Column, Layout 2 Column Wide Right and Layout 3 Column Wide Middle are not web template records in the demo portal or the target site export, so they are not extended.

Configured with an invented Bing Maps key (pp.list.map.credentials and Bingmaps/credentials, O9), which the service rejects: the map columns are stored except the default centre (pp.list.map.latitude/longitude: not stored, see notExpressed), and the map and geocoding need the key. Learn (List map view): only Bing maps are supported as the map type.
